title: UOS validation report 0.3
description: What a UOS validator reports, in a shape a program can act on. The message is written for whoever is debugging and may change between versions; the code is the contract.

uos_validation_report.description: Version of this report format, not of the container that was validated.

valid.description: True when no finding has severity `error`. Warnings do not invalidate a container.

findings.description: Every error and warning, errors first.

code.description: Stable identifier of the finding: UOS-E-<check> for an error, UOS-W-<check> for a warning, numeric part padded to three digits. This is what a program branches on.

severity.description: An error invalidates the container; a warning does not.

check.description: Row of the validation algorithm table that produced it, as the specification numbers them.

path.description: Where in the container the finding is: a manifest path such as `assets[3].uri`, or an entry path inside the ZIP. Null when the finding is about the container as a whole.

message.description: Human-readable explanation. Written for whoever is debugging, and not a stable interface.

levels.description: Conformance levels the container satisfies. Derived, never declared by the writer.

distributable.description: Whether the container is fit to leave the organisation that issued it. Orthogonal to the conformance levels.

not_distributable_because.description: What is missing for it to be distributable. Empty when `distributable` is true.

version.description: How many versions of the case are chained. Zero means no chain is declared, which is not the same as being the first version.

views.description: How many stored views the container carries.

external_count.description: How many acquired originals the container references without holding. A count and not one warning per asset, because referencing is the definition of the format rather than an exception.
